description: AIDA helps cinema and entertainment professionals analyze movies, theaters, showtimes, presales, box office results, historical occupancy, and audience forecasting. Ask questions in natural language to compare performance, track presale pace, review schedules, inspect realized market results, and combine signals across multiple data domains. Access depends on your organization's AIDA permissions.
